items.title_en: ‘Can Someone Remove That Guy in the Background?’ Woman’s Request To Edit Picture Inspires Memes
items.title_zh: “有人能把背景中的那个人去掉吗？”女人要求编辑照片激发了模因
items.summary_en: A woman wanted a guy standing in the background to be cropped out of her picture and asked internet users to help her with the edit which rather inspired funny memes on Twitter.
items.summary_zh: 一位女士希望从她的照片中剪掉站在背景中的一个男人，并请求互联网用户帮助她进行编辑，这在推特上激发了有趣的表情包。
